_about: Index of every building block for the style. status: draft -> proven (passes reel score + check) -> approved (user said yes). New entries are added only after user approval. "tpl:" paths live in the private template folder (/home/user/tpl, backed up to the private Kaggle dataset), never in git.

hero_word.blocked_by: car shape (different model) and WONDER font (Coolvetica Heavy Comp is paid); position fitting has converged

gen.use: opening hook: giant hero word + spinning prop + marks
one emphasised word in a pill, card shrinks

word_panel.weak: f181-184 black gap between the two wipes (0.5-0.8)

gen.use: line + huge word rising per letter
words fly in through a dusty dark room

statement_flip.weak: scan half: our MRI is a different scan (texture cannot match); layout/motion match

gen.use: statement with accent word, flips to a scan/map
documents fly past in the dark, strike/stamp
prop on a disc with a definition, scribble loop

word_prop_pop.notes: real iPhone 15 Pro Max (CC-BY-4.0 polyman); paper cut-out glove fist/open generated from OG frames

gen.use: cut-out prop pops, big serif word
box with 3 props swapping, verb in highlighter

calendar_flip.notes: page turn = per-frame clip mask + reflected dark flap (slow curl, fast sweep); window light = static multiply with lit polygons
calendar_flip.weak: bed is a different model; window shadow across the card is a flat screen-space approximation

gen.use: counter/calendar pages flip to a year or number

brain_collage.weak: number ring angle/blur and grid fine detail; fineprint was 60 px high in the scored render (fixed since)
brain_collage.notes: 3D brain.glb; number ring depth-split so it wraps round the brain

gen.use: prop centre + ring of words in depth

hand_flame.notes: rim-lit hand clip hand_rim_grab.mp4 (SCREEN), flame_loop.mp4 + warm halo

gen.use: rim-lit hand reaching for a glowing object

needle_wave.notes: follow_needle head (f845-882) dissolving over 3 f into the user-supplied move_the_needle recreation (templates/move_the_needle: measured wavy white reveal + halo, arm grip, dark wipe). Replaces follow_needle in Michelin S20 (user, 2026-11-21).
